rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload trip (X13 low) and set motor overload alarm M191.
Reset latched fault M190 on fault reset pushbutton X1 (PB-0002).
Combine latched fault, motor overload, and E-stop open into conveyor fault interlock M199.
Run conveyor motor contactor Y10 when auto mode is selected and no fault interlock is active.
Indicate pallet in position M100 when pallet at stop photo-eye X10 is blocked.
Latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of pallet release request X14.
Time stopper release solenoid Y11 active duration (2.0 s delay via T11).
Reset stopper release solenoid Y11 when timer T11 completes.
